jobs.description:
Robert Half is collaborating with a leading global player in the high‑tech manufacturing industry to recruit a Senior Business Controller (m/f/x).

Our client, an international organization active in advanced industrial technology, develops innovative solutions used in sectors such as energy‑efficient glass, consumer electronics, solar applications and industrial machinery. With production sites in the US, Europe and Asia, the company employs appr. 300 FTE's and operates in a fast‑growing, technology‑driven market.

Position

As a Senior Business Controller (m/f/x), you provide high‑quality financial insights to support strategic decisions across the group. You work closely with leadership teams in different regions and functions, contributing to stronger cost control, profitability analysis and data-driven planning.

This is a key function for an experienced finance professional who enjoys combining analytical depth with a strong business partnering mindset.

From out your role you will interact with the Group Controller and CFO.

Your responsibilities include:

• Managing and improving cost accounting across multiple sites, ensuring accurate standard costing and analyzing manufacturing structures.
• Providing insight into margins and product profitability, including variance analysis and margin reviews.
• Delivering monthly performance analyses across business units: actuals, budget, forecast, prior‑year comparisons.
• Highlighting trends, risks and opportunities, providing clear insights for management.
• Conducting analyses on pricing, capacity, product mix and working capital to support strategic decision-making.
• Developing dashboards, KPIs and Power BI reports to harmonize reporting across sites.
• Supporting budgeting, forecasting and long‑range planning, ensuring inputs align with strategic assumptions.
• Contributing to improvement projects such as M&A analyses, transfer pricing, sourcing optimization and cost accounting enhancements.
 

Your profile

• A bachelor's or master's degree in finance.
• At least 10 years of relevant experience in FP&A, controlling or a similar finance function, ideally in an international manufacturing or engineering environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
• Proficiency in Excel, ERP systems and experience building dashboards in Power BI (must).
• The ability to balance operational detail with a strategic helicopter view.
• Excellent planning and organizational skills, especially in a fast‑moving context.
• A plus: experience with consolidation systems or IFRS.
• We are looking for an English proficient professional. Dutch is not required.
• Willingness to travel internationally maximum 2 weeks each quarter.

Your first step into support. A hands-on opportunity to build real-worldnetworking expertise, even if you’re at the beginning of your career.

Our partner is a fast-growing technology company operating in theconnectivity and managed network servicesspace. As their activities continue to expand, they are looking for aSupport Engineerto join their technical team. 

 

This is more than a traditional support role: it’s a great opportunity for someone with a technical mindset who wants todevelop a career in networking, gain practical experience with different technologies, and progressively specialize in areas such asVPN, WAN, routing and SD-WAN.
Support Engineer - Your day to day
• Provide1st & 2nd line technical supportto customers via phone and ticketing systems.
• Configure and preparenetwork equipment and routersfor new deployments.
• Monitor network environments and proactively identify and resolveconnectivity issues.
• Manageequipment inventoryand ensure accurate tracking of technical assets.
• Participate in anon-call rotationto support customers and maintain high service availability.
• Supporton-site installationsfor new deployments across different environments and locations.
Support Engineer - More about you
• Some practical knowledge ofnetworking fundamentals, such as VLANs, VPNs, WAN/LAN, IP routing or basic firewall configuration.
• You may bejunior or at the start of your career— motivation and technical curiosity are more important than extensive experience.
• A strong interest inNetworking & Connectivity, with the ambition to develop deeper expertise in technologies such as SD-WAN and SDN.
• Acustomer-oriented mindsetand a genuine commitment to delivering a high-quality support experience.
• Strong communication skills inDutch and English; a good level of French is a plus.
• A proactive, hands-on personality with a genuineappetite for learning and solving technical challenges.

Responsibilities

• Oversee the progress of applications within the portfolio and report findings to project leadership.
• Challenge technical specifications and functional choices to ensure alignment with architectural standards.
• Maintain high code quality through rigorous reviews and established development guidelines.
• Lead and coach multiple development teams to coordinate sprint activities and resolve technical issues.
• Design and communicate a clear vision for the target architecture using industry-standard modeling.
• Organize collaborative technical sessions and workshops with developers and other architects.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in .NET architecture, microservices, and core development patterns.
• You bring 8+ years of expertise in architectural design using UML and Archimate.
• You possess 5+ years of experience in modern UI delivery with Blazor and Microfrontends.
• You're experienced with Azure cloud resources and Kubernetes components such as pods, ingress, and networking.
• You bring 3+ years of knowledge in Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Helm deployments.
• You have experience with testing methodologies including unit tests, feature tests, and mocking.
• You're proactive, analytical, and possess strong communication and coaching skills.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of German, French, or Dutch.

Our client, an international company located in the Ghent region, is looking for a Sourcing Analyst to expand the Procurement Team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sourcing Analyst you will be responsible for following domains:Category Management

• Address all areas of category management including category business plans, global market and pricing analysis, and procurement support.
• Contribute to the development of the company's strategic category objectives and goals.
• Assist in the development of global category strategies with defined plans for cost savings, risk assessment and mitigation, and service level agreements.
• Support the CM in developing and executing category negotiation strategies with suppliers, including specific targets for pricing, service, quality, intellectual property, tool ownership, exclusivity, and inventory.
• Monitor current category market conditions, technology roadmaps, and identify supply/demand challenges and opportunities.
• Develop subject matter expertise in assigned commodities through external research, benchmarking, and analysis of cost drivers and life cycle costs. Provide market intelligence and category price trends.

Sourcing Management

• Utilise the strategic sourcing process to manage assigned commodities and finished products across multiple locations and subsidiaries
• Identify all stakeholders for each major category and form cross-functional teams to define and implement strategies that reduce cost, improve quality, and strengthen the competitive position
• Provide rigorous analysis of spend data and market trends to prioritise and launch sourcing initiatives within designated categories
• Analyse current spend and evaluate current suppliers; consolidate spend across multiple manufacturing locations to create leverage
• Identify new high-potential suppliers
You work together with your (international) procurement team and will report to the Sourcing Manager.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field
• Minimum proven first solid professional experience in (strategic) sourcing, category management, or an equivalent procurement function
• Experience in a multinational or European industrial environment is a strong asset
• Demonstrated knowledge of strategic sourcing tools and processes in a global, multi-site manufacturing context
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities using contemporary tools and methods (Excel, ERP/procurement systems, spend analytics platforms)
• Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to articulate complex topics clearly at all organisational levels
• Proficiency in English is required
• Willingness to travel

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.

While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.

To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.

The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.

One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.

We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.

Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.

HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.

Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.

External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

Profile

We are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer: English + Czech + Polish OR Lituanian - Multiple shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English + Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish 

 
• You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

We are looking for an enthusiastic CNC miller for our production department.
 
Our client develops and manufactures modular systems for the live communications sector.
 
As a CNC miller, you will mill aluminum profiles according to drawings.
 
You will alternate between batch production and custom work.
 
In addition, you will use an ERP system to process production orders.
 
You will also be responsible for creating milling programs, setting up the milling machine, loading and unloading the machine, and performing quality checks.
 
Furthermore, you will perform first-line maintenance on the machine. 

• Experience as a CNC miller

• Ability to read blueprints and knowledge of using measuring instruments

• Quality-oriented, with a sense of order and neatness

• You are fluent in English

• Willing to work in a two-shift system

• Team player with a positive attitude

Our client is a leading international FMCG company with a strong portfolio of iconic brands and an established presence in the Belgian retail market.

Jobomschrijving

• Take full ownership of the commercial portfolio.
• Develop and maintain strong strategic customer relationships and act as the key commercial point of contact.
• Lead customer negotiations, Joint Business Plans, contracts and commercial agreements.
• Drive sales growth by identifying new business opportunities and developing customer-specific initiatives.
• Support the Channel Manager in defining sales strategies, commercial targets and promotional policies.
• Develop sales volume budgets and forecasts for assigned customers.
• Monitor customer spending, contractual agreements and commercial investments against budget

• Master's degree in Economics, Marketing, Business or equivalent experience.
• 5-10 years of experience in Sales, Trade Marketing or Key Account Management.
• Strong knowledge of the Belgian retail/FMCG market.
• Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with experience in budgeting, forecasting, business planning and claim management.
• Autonomous and comfortable taking full ownership of customer relationships.
• Strong presentation and communication skills.
• Excellent knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SAP is required.
• Fluent in French and English.

Our client is an international business law firm with a strong presence across Europe and a global network of more than 45 offices and over 3,000 lawyers worldwide. Its Brussels office brings together approximately 55 lawyers alongside a dedicated business support team, operating in a highly international and multicultural environment.

The Brussels office is characterised by a dynamic environment, with a broad variety of projects and regular interaction with international colleagues. Current areas of focus include digital transformation, EU regulation, ESG, artificial intelligence, pharmaceuticals and energy.

The culture is ambitious but supportive, with a strong emphasis on excellence, collaboration, innovation, accountability and client focus. The HR function plays an important role in maintaining this environment, supporting employees and Partners throughout the employee lifecycle.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage day-to-day HR administration and employee records in Workday.
• Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with Finance, employees and SD Worx.
• Manage employee benefits and support employees on Belgian HR legislation and social security matters.
• Coordinate full-cycle recruitment with Partners, candidates and external agencies.
• Manage onboarding and offboarding in collaboration with IT, Finance, Reception and other stakeholders.
• Coordinate performance review processes and follow up with employees and teams.
• Act as the main point of contact for employees throughout the employee lifecycle.
• Support the Brussels Office Manager and contribute to the continuous development of the HR function.

You have solid experience in HR administration or as an HR generalist and enjoy a hands-on role where you can take ownership and work autonomously.

• Strong knowledge of Belgian HR administration and social legislation.
• Comfortable with payroll processes; experience with SD Worx is a plus.
• Proactive, meticulous and highly organised.
• Mature and confident communicator, able to interact with Partners and senior stakeholders.
• Business-oriented HR sparring partner with a diplomatic but assertive approach.
• Fluent in English and French; Dutch is an asset.
• Experience with Workday is a plus.

You'll be part of a renewable energy consultancy with global reach, focused on creating sustainable solutions for tomorrow. The culture of the company is more informal but in a professional way, open and supportive, offering you both professional growth and the chance to contribute to meaningful projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain and update internal systems and databases (e.g. project tracking, HR and finance tools)
• Coordinate schedules and resources for internal programmes and training sessions
• Assist with reporting, data checks and preparing presentations for management
• Support HR processes such as onboarding administration and training follow-up
• Handle administrative follow-up for suppliers and internal approvals
• Ensure accurate documentation, filing and archiving (digital and hard copy)
• Take on ad hoc administrative tasks that keep the office and operations running smoothly

• 2+ years of experience in administration, coordination or office support
• Organised, detail-oriented and flexible in handling different priorities
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• A strong communicator in English, Dutch (and French)
• Proactive, service-minded and a natural team player
• Diploma in administration, business or similar is a plus but not required

You will be accountable for the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax product portfolio within Belgium. You will initiate and implement the local sales strategy securing a solid market share for your region.

• You will step up, maintain, expand and develop long-term relationships with new & existing clients in order to achieve and exceed sales targets.
• You will proactively identify and pursue business opportunities across diverse industries such as Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. By ensuring a close interaction with your key stakeholders you keep abreast on upcoming projects and needs.
• You are able to translate your customer’s challenges into qualitative solutions, ensuring fulfillment of their business needs whilst pursuing customer satisfaction, through dedicated business partnering.
• You will keep abreast of market trends and data, related to the FILOform & Wallmax Product Portfolio and industries, to identify and determine market opportunities, increase the business market share and secure further market penetration.
• You will present business reports, sales reports and forecasts on a monthly basis.
• You will liaise with internal and external stakeholders across all sites, as appropriate.
• You will be updating the CRM tools (Salesforce, …).
• You will report directly to the Sales Manager BENE with who you will have close interactions and regular meetings.

• Bachelor or Master background combined with a senior technical sales experience with a proven track record and client portfolio within the Energy, Infrastructure, Data or Telecom sector. 
• Demonstrated history of achieving sales targets, growing revenue, analyzing and following-up on KPI’s.
